description: Recompute one business's KaiCalls trust level now from its live account activity (card on file, paid bills, days active, real customer calls) and save the result, the same recheck the dashboard runs, for example right after the owner adds a card. Returns the same view as get_trust_level plus whether the level moved up or down. Requires current business membership. Replaces the saved derived state, may record level-change history and may email the current owner when standing changes. It can only reflect what the account has earned; it never sets or raises a level by request.

business_id.description: Business ID (optional only when the token reaches exactly one business).

focus.description: 'standing' (default): the current level and next steps. 'ladder': every level. 'level': the one named in level. 'outbound': today's outbound calls and texts against the limits this level allows, and the step that raises them.

level.description: A level key or name, e.g. 'pro'. Used with focus 'level'.

name: recheck_trust_level
title: Recheck Trust Level
